extDescription.message: Fixes for Canvas LMS students: a weekly to-do list, missing work and due dates.

timesInLong.message: Times are in the Canvas time zone, $1.

ringLabelPastDue.message: $1: $2 of $3 done this week, $4 past due

redoTip.message: Resubmit in Canvas to finish this.

tipOutsideHandIn.message: Canvas can't see this hand-in. Check it off when you hand it in.

tipCantConfirm.message: Canvas can't see this hand-in. If you handed it in, check it off.

tipMissingInCanvas.message: You checked this off, but Canvas still marks it missing.

tipMissingInCanvasTeacher.message: You checked this off, but your teacher marked it missing in Canvas.

tipRedoDone.message: You checked this off, but your teacher asked for a redo.

tipClosed.message: Canvas no longer accepts a hand-in.

staleLine.message: Couldn't refresh. Showing your list from $1.

limitedLine.message: Your school limits the Canvas planner. Pages, ungraded discussions, ungraded quizzes, peer reviews, discussions with reply due dates and your own tasks can't show.

hiddenCourseHere.message: You hid this course from the weekly list.

noteFirstDone.message: Done marks sync to Canvas and its apps. On a module item, this can count as 'Mark as done'.

noteFirstSkip.message: Skipping also hides this item in Canvas's list of missing work.

setupIntro.message: Open Canvas in a tab and click the Tools for Canvas button there. Or type the address you use to sign in to Canvas.

addressInvalid.message: Enter a web address, such as school.instructure.com.

allowAccessHint.message: Your browser then asks you to let Tools for Canvas read this site. It talks only to your Canvas.

noAccessTitle.message: Tools for Canvas needs access to your Canvas

noAccessBody.message: Allow access to $1 to show your list.

redirectsBody.message: Open Canvas in a tab and sign in. Then click the Tools for Canvas button in the toolbar while that tab is open.

notCanvasTitle.message: This address is not a Canvas site

notCanvasBody.message: Check the address and try again.

firefoxPrivateHint.message: In a private window or a container tab, Firefox keeps a separate sign-in. Sign in to Canvas in a normal window.

noCoursesBody.message: Canvas shows no active courses for you at $1.

taskSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the task. Try again.

taskTimeHint.message: With no time, the task is set for $1.

weekStartHelp.message: Automatic takes the first day from your Canvas language.

hiddenCoursesHelp.message: Hide a course, such as a club or an orientation course. Its work leaves your list and your rings.

noCoursesYet.message: Your courses show here after your list loads.

settingShowOnCanvas.message: Show the weekly list on Canvas pages

showOnCanvasHelp.message: Shows on the Card View and Recent Activity dashboards and on course home pages. On other pages, use the side panel.

themeHelp.message: Automatic follows your browser or system. On Canvas pages, the list follows the page.

welcomeIntro.message: Fixes for Canvas LMS students, starting with a weekly to-do list.

welcomePinTitle.message: Pin the Tools for Canvas button

welcomePinChrome.message: Click the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) in the toolbar. Then click the pin next to Tools for Canvas.

welcomePinEdge.message: Click the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) in the toolbar. Then click the eye next to Tools for Canvas.

welcomePinFirefox.message: Click the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) in the toolbar. Then click the gear next to Tools for Canvas and choose Pin to Toolbar.

welcomeOpenBody.message: Your list shows on the Canvas dashboard and on course home pages. On any page, click the Tools for Canvas button to open or close it in the side panel.

welcomeOpenBodyFirefox.message: Your list shows on the Canvas dashboard and on course home pages. On any page, click the Tools for Canvas button to open or close it in the sidebar.

welcomeNoShortcut.message: You can also set a keyboard shortcut on the extension shortcuts page of your browser.

welcomeReady.message: All set. Tools for Canvas uses $1.

welcomeReadyNext.message: Open your Canvas dashboard to see your week.
